rows.label: tlk70000077_03_msg0001
rows.name:
I've been to the Iiran capital
often for work, and their mechanical
technology always amazes me!

rows.label: tlk70000077_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Even after years as a mechanic in
Superbia, there was lots of technology
I couldn't fully understand.

rows.label: tlk70000077_03_msg0003
rows.name:
What surprised me most was the theory
behind a high-output power system that
doesn't require a Divine Beast.

rows.label: tlk70000077_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Back in Superbia, it's usual to use
Divine Beasts as a power source for
vehicles. That's the big difference.

rows.label: tlk70000077_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Iiran cooking, though... Well...being
used to Superbian food like I am, I
couldn't get a taste for it.
